Action Performed: Conformal deposition of silicon dioxide (SiO<sub>2</sub>) to form the fin spacer oxide layer.
Etching of the deposited fin spacer oxide to retain the required spacer structure.
Deposition of silicon dioxide (SiO<sub>2</sub>) for P-type spacer formation.
Deposition of silicon nitride (Si<sub>3</sub>N<sub>4</sub>) over the P-type spacer structure.
Etching of the deposited P-type spacer nitride layer.
Deposition of silicon nitride (Si<sub>3</sub>N<sub>4</sub>) for N-type spacer formation.
Etching of the deposited N-type spacer nitride layer.
